core.okHelp: The part that captures the game's screen and reads its text (subquest_core.dll) is working.
core.missingHelp: The part that captures the game's screen and reads its text (subquest_core.dll) wasn't found: without it, games can't be listed or translated. Reinstall Subquest. If you're building from source, build the core folder (see the README).

game.question: Which game are we translating?
game.hint: Run the game in windowed or borderless mode. It will show up here.
game.empty: No windows open. Start the game and refresh the list.

area.question: Where does the text show up?
area.dialogueHelp: Faster and more precise. Mark one or more areas: dialogue, song lyrics, names…
area.screenHelp: For menus, items and signs all over. Slower: looks for text in the whole window.
area.previewLabel: Live image of the game window
area.drag: Drag over the image to mark where the dialogue appears.
area.wholeWindow: The whole window will be read.
area.name: Area name
area.unmarked: "{name}" has no rectangle yet: mark it on the preview or remove the area.
area.editHint: Drag inside to move, the small squares to resize, or outside to mark it again.
area.previewPeeking: Showing the game for a moment so it draws its screen…
area.previewStuck: The game isn't drawing its screen. It may be minimized, or paused while in the background.

start.question: All set.
start.summary: I'll read {game} in {source} and show the translation in {target}.
start.waiting: Waiting for the first line to appear in the game…
start.timing: OCR in {ocr} ms, {total} ms since capture
start.cached: Repeated line, from cache in {ms} ms
start.quickDone: Quick translation in {ms} ms (the main one didn't answer)
start.toolbarHint: In the game, {keys} shows or hides the bar for marking areas and taking style prints.
start.toolbarHintNoKey: The in-game bar has no shortcut; use the button below or set one in Shortcuts.

play.applyTimeout: The areas were saved, but reading took too long to restart. Stop and start translating again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHelp: Stays on your computer only. Leave empty for local models.
settings.showOriginal: Show the original text above the translation
settings.previewOriginal: 橋が落ちている。別の道を探すしかない。
settings.previewText: The bridge is out. You'll have to find another way across.
settings.apiKeyGemini: Create a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. It stays on your computer only.
settings.fetchModelsError: Couldn't fetch the models. Check the address and the key.
settings.modelsFound: {count} text models available. Pick one from the list.
settings.modelHelp: For dialogue, prefer a fast model (the "flash" ones, for example).
settings.visionModelHelp: Optional. Recognizing fonts is hard; a stronger model (e.g. a "pro" one) gets closer. Empty uses the translation model.
settings.translationIntro: The good translation: it understands context and fixes reading errors. It replaces the quick one as soon as it arrives.

quick.title: Quick translator
quick.intro: A gap filler: shows up in a few tenths of a second while the main one thinks, so lines that vanish fast still get translated.

engines.googleHelp: Free, no key. Not an official API and may change.
engines.deeplHelp: Official API, free plan with 500k characters a month. Needs a key.

quick.deeplKeyHelp: Create one for free at deepl.com/pro-api. Free-plan keys end in ":fx".

storage.title: Storage
storage.intro: The line history is kept in memory only and is gone when Subquest closes. What stays on disk are the translations already made, so repeated lines show at once (20 thousand at most, a few MB).

look.title: How the translation shows
look.inPlaceHelp: Each translated line is drawn where the original was, with its colors, size and its style's font.
look.classicHelp: A dark box with all the text, like a movie subtitle. Simpler, always readable.
look.inPlaceNote: Each line's font comes from the game's styles (Games tab). Color and size are measured on screen.

settings.fontSizeAutoHelp: Automatic: as big as the game's own letters

errors.coreMissing: Core not found. Build the core folder and reopen Subquest.
errors.invalidArg: Something wrong was sent to the core. Try again; if it repeats, report the issue.
errors.alreadyRunning: A translation is already running. Stop it before starting another.
errors.platform: Windows refused to capture this window. Make sure the game is open, windowed or borderless, and not minimized.
errors.notImplemented: This part is still being built. It arrives in the next steps of phase 1.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Details are in the console (F12).
errors.ocrLanguage: Windows doesn't have text recognition (OCR) for the game's language. In Settings > Time & language > Language & region, add the game's language (for example, English (United States)); OCR comes with it. Then reopen Subquest.
errors.translatorNotConfigured: The translator isn't set up yet: check the model and address in Settings.
errors.translatorNetwork: Couldn't reach the translation service. Check your internet and the address in Settings.
errors.translatorProvider: The translation service refused the request. Check the key and model in Settings; if it is a usage limit, wait a bit.
errors.translatorBusy: The model is overloaded right now (high demand). Try again in a few seconds or pick another model in Settings; the "flash-lite" ones are usually free.
errors.fontNotFound: None of the suggested fonts exist on Google Fonts. Try again or mark an area with more text.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.intro: Import font files so the translation looks like the game. They're kept in Subquest's folder; nothing is installed in Windows.
fonts.importHelp: Click or drop .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 files here.

detect.title: Game font
detect.help: The translation model looks at the marked area and suggests similar fonts from Google Fonts.

history.title: History
history.summary: {game}: {count} lines, {missed} passed before their translation was ready.
history.noSession: The session's lines show up here.
history.search: Search the original or the translation
history.onlyMissed: Only the ones that passed too fast
history.empty: No lines yet. Start translating a game and everything that shows up is kept here.
history.missedBadge: Lines that passed before their translation was ready

styles.title: Game styles
styles.intro: Each game writes different things in different fonts. Take a print of a phrase and pick its font: every line whose letters look the same (weight, contrast, slant) uses that font, at any size. Color only breaks ties.
styles.takeHelp: Drag over a phrase in the game. Shortcut: {keys}.
styles.takeNeedsGame: Start translating this game to take prints of it.
styles.color: Letter color measured on the print
styles.noFont: Pick a font for this style to take effect.
styles.searchHelp: The model looks at this style's print and suggests fonts; the one you keep applies to this style only.

toolbar.area: Mark an area in the game
toolbar.close: Hide the bar · {keys} brings it back
toolbar.edit: Edit the areas in the game
toolbar.closeNoKey: Hide the bar · Subquest brings it back

select.style: Mark a phrase in this style
select.howTo: Drag over the game. Right click cancels.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Keys that work inside the game while it is translated. Click the key and press the new combination.
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts only work while a game is being translated; the rest of the time these keys belong to other programs again. If another program already uses a combination, it won't work: change it here.

errors.needsModifier: Use it with Ctrl, Alt or Win (only F1–F12 may go alone).
errors.unsupportedKey: That key can't be a shortcut. Use letters, digits, F1–F12, arrows or Space.

toolbar.name: Show the bar
toolbar.help: Shows or hides the bar over the game.

area.name: Mark area
area.help: Drag a rectangle in the game; the new area is read right away.

style.name: Style print
style.help: Drag over a phrase to pick that style's font.

pause.name: Pause
pause.help: Stops reading the game, and back.

hide.name: Hide translations
hide.help: Takes the translations off the screen without stopping.

edit.name: Edit areas
edit.help: Move, resize, rename or remove the areas right in the game.

areaEditor.title: Edit areas
areaEditor.help: Drag inside to move, by the small squares to resize, on empty space to add. Click the name to rename.

games.title: Games
games.intro: Everything saved for each game: where its text boxes are, and its styles. A style is a print of a phrase from the game with the font that matches it: every line with similar letters then uses that font.
games.empty: No games yet. When you translate a game, its areas and styles show up here.
games.forget: Forget this game (areas, styles and prints)
games.areasHint: To move, resize or add areas, use Play → Adjust areas, or the bar while playing.
games.fallback: Lines that look like no style use the font of the closest one.

welcome.title: Welcome to Subquest
welcome.text: It reads the game's text on screen and draws the translation over it, where the original was. First of all: run the game windowed or borderless. Exclusive fullscreen blocks the capture.

translator.title: The main translator
translator.text: Put the API key of the translating service here (Gemini has a free key). It understands the conversation and fixes reading mistakes. Use "Test translation" to check everything works.

quick.title: The quick layer
quick.text: While the main translator thinks, a quick translation shows first and is replaced by the good one as soon as it arrives. The subtitle never waits.

game.title: Pick the game
game.text: With the game open, pick its window here. Then mark where the text appears: only in marked areas (faster) or anywhere on screen.

styles.title: Styles: the game's look
styles.text: While playing, take a print of a phrase (bar or shortcut) and pick its font here. Every line with similar letters then uses that font.

toolbar.title: Shortcuts and the bar
toolbar.text: In the game, these keys mark areas, take style prints, pause and hide the translation. One of them shows the bar, which does all that with the mouse.

history.title: History
history.text: Lines that went by too fast stay here, with their translation. The number in the menu says how many you missed.

done.title: All set!
done.text: This button opens the tour again whenever you want. Have fun!
